plugin.name: Tasks Map
plugin.description: A graph view of your tasks

commands.insert_filter_as_code_block: Insert current filter as embedded Tasks Map

view.title: Tasks map
view.dataview_required: Tasks Map requires the Dataview plugin to be installed and enabled.
view.dataview_not_installed: The Dataview plugin is not currently installed.
view.dataview_disabled: The Dataview plugin is installed but not enabled.
view.visit_community_plugins: Visit the Community Plugins section in Settings to install or enable Dataview.
view.plugin_not_found_description: The Tasks Map plugin instance could not be resolved. Try closing and reopening the view.

gantt.empty: No tasks found in your vault
gantt.empty_filtered: No tasks match the current search
gantt.bar_tooltip: {{start}} to {{end}} — drag to move, drag an edge to resize
gantt.bar_inferred_tooltip: Suggested {{start}} to {{end}} — not saved yet; drag to schedule
gantt.inferred_hint: {{n}} tasks have suggested dates (dashed). Drag one, or use Apply suggested dates, to write them to your notes.
gantt.apply_inferred_desc: Write every suggested date to its note
gantt.applied_inferred_partial: Scheduled {{n}} tasks, {{failed}} could not be written
gantt.resize_columns: Drag to resize the task column
gantt.add_task_desc: Add a task at the end of the list
gantt.add_task_after: Add a task after this one
gantt.linking_hint: Linking from "{{task}}" — click the task it should block.
gantt.skip_weekends_desc: Measure durations in working days and keep bars off weekends: a task starting Friday that takes 4 days ends the following Wednesday
gantt.multiselect_hint: Ctrl-click to select several tasks, then drag any one of them to move them all
gantt.moved_together_hint: {{n}} tasks selected — drag any one of them to move them all
gantt.tag_failed: Could not update the task tags
gantt.show_in_map: Show this task on the map
gantt.critical_path_desc: Pick out the chain of tasks that decides the finish date, and show how much slack the rest have
gantt.critical_path_hint: Plan finishes {{finish}} — {{n}} tasks on the critical path have no slack.
gantt.at_risk_hint: {{n}} tasks need attention: overdue, never started, or scheduled before what they wait on.
gantt.tooltip_critical: On the critical path — no slack
gantt.tooltip_behind: {{n}} days later than the plan allows

task_create.no_target_note: Open a note first, or add a task to one, so Tasks Map knows where to write
task_create.could_not_read: That task could not be read back — nothing was changed
task_create.insert_failed: Could not put that task into the chain
task_create.chain_healed: Reconnected {{n}} links around the deleted task

retrofit.title: Create notes for existing tasks
retrofit.body: This will create up to {{n}} notes in "{{folder}}" and rewrite those task lines to link to them. Tasks that are already links are left alone.
retrofit.nothing_to_do: Every task already links to a note
retrofit.done_partial: Linked {{n}} tasks; {{skipped}} could not be updated

settings.show_task_priorities_desc: Display priority indicators on task nodes
settings.show_status_counts_desc: Display a status counts overlay on the canvas
settings.edge_style_desc: The line style used for connections between nodes
settings.smooth_step_radius_desc: Border radius for smooth step corners (0 = sharp right angles)
settings.tag_color_palette_desc: Choose a color theme for tags
settings.tag_colors_desc: Assign a fixed color to a tag. Tags set to "Theme color" follow the palette above.
settings.tag_colors_reset_desc: Clear every manually assigned tag color
settings.no_tags_found: No tags found in your tasks yet
settings.linking_style_desc: How task dependencies are specified in simple tasks
settings.linking_individual_desc: Each dependency with its own emoji identifier
settings.linking_dataview_desc: Dependencies using Dataview inline field syntax
settings.debug_visualization_desc: Show additional debug information in the graph view
settings.language_desc: Select the language for the plugin interface
settings.companion_notes: Create a note for each new task
settings.companion_notes_desc: New tasks are written as a link to their own note, so there is always somewhere to keep the detail. Existing tasks are left alone.
settings.finance_enabled_desc: Track hours, people and costs on tasks, and show the finance dashboard
settings.finance_rate_note_desc: Note holding the grade-to-rate and person-to-grade tables
settings.finance_rate_note_missing: No rates note yet — create one to start pricing tasks
settings.finance_default_hours_desc: Hours a person works in a day when a task does not say otherwise
settings.finance_currency_desc: Currency costs are shown in; rates in the note are plain numbers
settings.finance_include_inferred_desc: Count tasks whose Gantt dates were suggested rather than written

controls.title: View
controls.open_gantt_desc: Open the Gantt view for these tasks
controls.undo_desc: Take back the last change made in either view

unlinked_panel.title: Unlinked tasks
unlinked_panel.drag_hint: Drag a task onto the graph to place it

graph.no_tasks_hint: No tasks found in your vault.
graph.all_unlinked_hint: Drag tasks from the panel on the left onto the graph to place them here.

errors.cannot_create_edges_different_types: Cannot create edges between different task types (dataview and note-based tasks). Both tasks must be of the same type.
errors.cannot_insert_task_between_non_dataview: Insert task between edges is only supported for Dataview tasks.

embed.dataview_required: Tasks Map requires the Dataview plugin.
embed.invalid_json: This Tasks Map embed contains invalid JSON. Re-insert it using the command palette to fix it.
embed.legacy_format: This Tasks Map embed uses an outdated format. Re-insert it using the command palette to migrate it.

finance.modal_schedule_suggested: Dates suggested, not yet written — {{days}} days
finance.modal_hours_per_day_desc: Leave empty to use the default from settings
finance.modal_total_hours_desc: Overrides the daily rate when set
finance.modal_line_crowded: This task's line is getting long — consider giving it a note
finance.write_failed: Could not write the finance data to that task
finance.day_mode_desc: How the Gantt counts days, which changes every hours-per-day figure

finance.kpi_total_excluded: {{amount}} more sits on {{count}} tasks with suggested dates
finance.kpi_hours_unpriced: {{hours}} h have no rate behind them
finance.spread_note: Each task cost is spread evenly across the days of its bar
finance.issue_unknown-person: {{count}} allocations to somebody not in the rates note
finance.issue_no-rate: {{count}} allocations whose grade has no rate
finance.issue_allocations-off: {{count}} tasks whose shares do not total 100%
finance.issue_no-allocations: {{count}} tasks with hours but nobody on them
finance.issue_rate_note: {{count}} rows in the rates note could not be read
finance.rate_problem_duplicate-grade: Duplicate grade, the first was kept
finance.rate_problem_duplicate-person: Duplicate person, the first was kept
finance.rate_problem_unknown-grade: Grade is not in the rates table
